patent an invention: Before showing her new design to any company, the young engineer decided to patent an invention so no one could copy it.
在向任何公司展示新設計之前，這位年輕工程師決定為發明申請專利，讓別人無法抄襲。
hold a patent: The company is rich because it holds a patent for a special battery used in millions of phones.
這家公司很有錢，因為它持有一項用於數百萬支手機的特殊電池專利。
patrol the streets: After the robbery, more police officers began to patrol the streets at night to make people feel safe.
搶案發生後，更多警察開始在夜間巡邏街道，讓民眾感到安心。
patrol the border: Soldiers patrol the border day and night to stop people from entering the country illegally.
士兵日夜巡邏邊境，阻止人們非法入境。
on patrol: Two police officers on patrol noticed smoke coming from the building and quickly called the fire department.
兩名巡邏中的警察注意到大樓冒出煙，迅速打電話給消防隊。
pattern one's life after: She decided to pattern her life after her grandmother, who always helped others and never complained.
她決定以奶奶為榜樣生活，奶奶總是幫助別人，從不抱怨。
patterned on the British system: Hong Kong's school system was patterned on the British system and copied many of its exams and rules.
香港的學校制度仿照英國制度，沿用了它許多考試和規定。
pattern of behavior: The teacher noticed a pattern of behavior: Kevin was always late on Mondays and seemed very tired.
老師注意到一種行為模式：凱文星期一總是遲到，而且看起來非常疲倦。
pause for thought: The question was so difficult that even the smartest student had to pause for thought before answering.
這個問題難到連最聰明的學生在回答前都得停下來思考。
pause the video: Could you pause the video for a minute? I need to answer the phone and don't want to miss anything.
你可以暫停影片一下嗎？我需要接電話，不想錯過任何內容。
give someone pause: The high price of the tickets gave us pause, so we decided to think about it before buying them.
票價太高令我們三思，所以我們決定先考慮一下再買。
without pause: The excited child talked without pause for the whole car ride, telling us everything about her trip.
這個興奮的孩子一路上不停地說話，把她旅行的一切都告訴我們。
pave the way for: Her success in the science competition helped pave the way for other girls at our school to join the team.
她在科學競賽中的成功，為我們學校其他女生加入團隊鋪了路。
pave the road: The city government plans to pave the road to the village so that buses can reach it more easily.
市政府計劃鋪通往村莊的路，讓公車能更容易到達那裡。
streets paved with gold: Many young people move to big cities hoping to find streets paved with gold, but life there is often hard.
許多年輕人搬到大城市，希望找到遍地黃金的地方，但那裡的生活往往很辛苦。
prices peaked: Housing prices peaked at their highest level ever in 2024 and have been dropping slowly since then.
房價在2024年到頂，達到史上最高點，之後一直緩慢下跌。
peak in summer: Electricity use tends to peak in summer, when almost every family turns on the air conditioner all day.
用電量往往在夏季達高峰，那時幾乎每個家庭整天開著冷氣。
at one's peak: At his peak, the baseball player hit more than fifty home runs in a single season.
在巔峰時期，這位棒球選手一個球季擊出超過五十支全壘打。
peak performance: Getting enough sleep before a big game helps athletes reach peak performance on the field.
大賽前睡飽能幫助運動員在場上發揮巔峰表現。
peak hours: The MRT is extremely crowded during peak hours, so I try to leave home before seven in the morning.
捷運在尖峰時段非常擁擠，所以我盡量早上七點前出門。
pedal a bicycle: It was hard to pedal a bicycle up the steep hill, so I got off and walked the rest of the way.
踩腳踏車上陡坡很吃力，所以我下車用走的走完剩下的路。
back-pedal on a promise: The mayor began to back-pedal on a promise to build a new park after he learned how much it would cost.
市長得知費用後，開始收回興建新公園的承諾。
soft-pedal the issue: The company tried to soft-pedal the issue of pollution, saying the dirty river was not a serious problem.
這家公司試圖淡化污染議題，聲稱河川變髒不是嚴重問題。
peel off a label: Before recycling the plastic bottle, please peel off a label and rinse the bottle with water.
回收塑膠瓶之前，請撕下標籤並用水沖洗瓶子。
paint peels: In this wet weather, the paint peels off the old walls, so we have to repaint the house every few years.
在這種潮濕的天氣下，舊牆上的油漆剝落，所以我們每隔幾年就得重新粉刷房子。
peel away the layers: As the story goes on, the writer slowly peels away the layers of the hero's past to show his true feelings.
隨著故事發展，作者層層剝開主角的過去，展現他真實的情感。
keep one's eyes peeled: Keep your eyes peeled for a gas station, because the car is almost out of fuel.
睜大眼睛注意有沒有加油站，因為車子快沒油了。
peer into the darkness: Hearing a strange noise outside, I opened the window and tried to peer into the darkness.
聽到外面有奇怪的聲音，我打開窗戶，試著凝視黑暗。
peer at the screen: Without her glasses, my grandmother had to peer at the screen to read the tiny words in the message.
沒戴眼鏡時，我奶奶得盯著螢幕看，才能讀出訊息裡的小字。
peer pressure: Many teenagers start smoking because of peer pressure, since they want to be accepted by their friends.
許多青少年因為同儕壓力而開始抽菸，因為他們想被朋友接納。
peer review: Before a science paper is published, it must go through peer review by other experts in the field.
科學論文發表之前，必須經過該領域其他專家的同儕審查。
